answer.original_source: Wendell Weeks, Corning Chairman, CEO and President, quoted by Fox News Digital on 2026-07-01 (party statement)
answer.new_information: Weeks said Corning would probably double its size over the coming years, with almost all new hires in advanced manufacturing and a significant part in the US. The period end and the meaning of 'size' (revenue, headcount or capacity) are not stated. The Fox items on the NVIDIA-Corning project (three facilities, more than 3,000 jobs, tenfold US optical capacity) and on Wistron's Texas operations are undated third-party relays with no completion date or job split, and none is stored against a question. The record has no same_claim_as pieces, so independence is true on the record's own terms.
